description: This file is a CMake script for detecting CUDA GPU architectures and generating appropriate compiler flags for nvcc. It includes functions for autodetecting installed GPUs and selecting architecture flags based on user input or detected hardware, with detailed configuration for different CUDA versions.

methods.name: CUDA_DETECT_INSTALLED_GPUS
methods.description: Detects installed CUDA GPUs and outputs their compute capabilities, using CUDA runtime functions or a generated test program.

methods.name: CUDA_SELECT_NVCC_ARCH_FLAGS
methods.description: Selects appropriate nvcc architecture flags based on provided architecture list or autodetected GPU compute capabilities.
